content:
**ADR-0023 citation must avoid bare token in docs/inbox**

What: While writing docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md for issue #755, found and applied the reserved-draft citation form for ADR-0023 established by #599.

Why: test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs scans docs/ (a REQUIRED_ROOT) for the exact pattern `ADR-(\d{4})(?!\d)` and fails if the number doesn't resolve to a file in brain/project/decisions/. ADR-0023 has no such file yet — only a draft at brain/project/decisions/brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md — so any bare "ADR-0023" token in a live docs/ file is unresolved rot. Commit 387e0e0 (#599) already reworded the only prior offenders in docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md and docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md to say "el draft `brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md`" or "el número `0023` reservado" instead of the bare token.

Where: test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs (the guard); docs/inbox/ROADMAP-M5-M8.md (three spots reworded: the Etapa 3 "who" line, the S3 bullet, and the §8 cross-check table row, all converted from bare "ADR-0023" to "el draft `adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md`").

Learned: the regex is case-sensitive and requires exactly 4 digits with a negative lookahead, so writing "0023" alone (backtick-quoted, no "ADR-" prefix) or the full draft path both dodge it safely; only the literal "ADR-0023" string trips the scan. The check's REQUIRED_ROOTS list includes docs/ explicitly, so docs/inbox/** is in scope and cannot be silently narrowed out (a G1 guard fails the suite if a required root stops contributing scanned files).
